howto: Pick your age band, then Math Mode or Spelling Mode.
Dig down with the arrows (or the dig pad). Every dig costs energy.
Walk into a rock with a sum carved on it and pick the gem with the right answer (in Spelling, tap the letters in order).
Ride the elevator up (E) to sell your ore, then spend it in the shop.
tips: Stuck on a rock? HINT teaches the step: make a ten, count up on a number line, or the next sound in the word.
A wrong answer hardens the rock for two seconds and costs one energy, so read the hint before trying again.
Go up before your energy hits zero: the winch drags you home and the run ends.
Deeper bands pay more for ore (coal, iron, gold, diamond) but ask harder questions.
A Battery Tank gives more energy per descent; the Elevator Shaft starts you deeper.

controls.keyboard: Arrows or WASD move and dig; type an answer and press Enter, or click a gem; E rides the elevator up; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Dig pad (bottom right) moves and digs; tap a gem to answer; ELEVATOR UP and HINT sit in the top bar.

difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and the questions step up inside that range as you dig deeper: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the title; depth ramps the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT in the puzzle panel and the top bar (and the arcade Hint): a number-line, make-a-ten, skip-count or next-sound nudge for the question in front of you
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the title (all time) and on the results card (this descent): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Mine coach runs on the first descent (dig, open a rock, answer, ride up); skip it or replay it from the title
features.results: Back on the Surface card: ore sold, rocks solved, misses, deepest point and the grown-up report
